title: MetaEvidence v1.0.0: reproducible cross-database evidence retrieval and externally validated bibliographic deduplication
description: MetaEvidence is an open-source Python framework for systematic reviews and meta-analysis. It supports source-neutral query representation, cross-database retrieval adapters, provenance-preserving bibliographic deduplication, study-level publication linkage, screening interoperability, PRISMA-oriented reporting, reproducibility manifests, and locked external-validation workflows. Version 1.0.0 preserves the externally validated publication-deduplication engine (SHA-256 3dfe93fb3b1a495a6e26ddca8ab0ab4b0f64bac047de3de07d1d5f1f893dca50) and includes results-only validation evidence without redistributing third-party benchmark data.
